package lengths_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	client "example.com/lengths/gen/http/lengths/client"
	server "example.com/lengths/gen/http/lengths/server"
	svc "example.com/lengths/gen/lengths"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
)

type (
	failingCloser struct {
		cause error
	}
	service struct {
		length chan *int64
	}
	countedBody struct {
		io.Reader
		closes atomic.Int32
	}
	doer struct {
		calls atomic.Int32
	}
)

func TestMountedRawLengths(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, body string
		length     *int64
	}{
		{"positive", "xyz", new(int64(3))},
		{"zero", "", new(int64(0))},
		{"absent", "xyz", nil},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			s := &service{length: make(chan *int64, 1)}
			mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
			server.Mount(mux, server.New(svc.NewEndpoints(s), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
			host := httptest.NewServer(mux)
			defer host.Close()
			c := client.NewClient("http", strings.TrimPrefix(host.URL, "http://"), host.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
			_, err := c.Optional()(context.Background(), &svc.OptionalRequestData{Payload: &svc.OptionalPayload{Length: tc.length}, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(tc.body))})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, tc.length, <-s.length)
		})
	}
}

func TestNominalRequiredLengths(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"required", "named"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "http://example.test", io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("abc")))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			if name == "required" {
				err = client.EncodeRequiredRequest(nil)(req, &svc.RequiredRequestData{Payload: &svc.RequiredPayload{Length: 3}, Body: req.Body})
			} else {
				err = client.EncodeNamedRequest(nil)(req, &svc.NamedRequestData{Payload: &svc.NamedPayload{Length: svc.LengthMarker("3")}, Body: req.Body})
			}
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.EqualValues(t, 3, req.ContentLength)
		})
	}
}

func TestFailuresBeforeDo(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"header", "nonempty zero", "canceled"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			transport := new(doer)
			c := client.NewClient("http", "example.test", transport, loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
			b := &countedBody{Reader: strings.NewReader("abc")}
			payload := &svc.OptionalPayload{}
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			defer cancel()
			switch name {
			case "header":
				payload.Tags = []string{"bad,item"}
			case "nonempty zero":
				payload.Length = new(int64(0))
			case "canceled":
				cancel()
				payload.Length = new(int64(0))
			}
			_, err := c.Optional()(ctx, &svc.OptionalRequestData{Payload: payload, Body: b})
			require.Error(t, err)
			require.Zero(t, transport.calls.Load())
			require.EqualValues(t, 1, b.closes.Load())
		})
	}
}

func TestEncoderFinalBody(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"custom", "form", "ordinary"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "http://example.test", nil)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			length := int64(3)
			switch name {
			case "custom":
				factory := func(r *http.Request) loomhttp.Encoder {
					r.Body = io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("abc"))
					r.GetBody = func() (io.ReadCloser, error) {
						return io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("abc")), nil
					}
					return loomhttp.EncodingFunc(func(any) error {
						return nil
					})
				}
				err = client.EncodeEncodedRequest(factory)(req, &svc.EncodedPayload{Length: &length, Value: "value"})
			case "form":
				length = int64(len("value=x"))
				err = client.EncodeFormRequest(nil)(req, &svc.FormPayload{Length: &length, Value: "x"})
			case "ordinary":
				length = int64(len(`{"value":"x"}`))
				err = client.EncodeOrdinaryRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder)(req, &svc.OrdinaryPayload{Length: &length, Value: "x"})
			}
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, length, req.ContentLength)
			body, err := io.ReadAll(req.Body)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Len(t, body, int(length))
			require.NoError(t, req.Body.Close())
			replay, err := req.GetBody()
			require.NoError(t, err)
			again, err := io.ReadAll(replay)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, body, again)
			require.NoError(t, replay.Close())
		})
	}
}

func TestCustomEncodingFailure(t *testing.T) {
	cause := errors.New("custom encoder")
	closeCause := errors.New("custom close")
	req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "http://example.test", nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	factory := func(r *http.Request) loomhttp.Encoder {
		r.Body = &failingCloser{cause: closeCause}
		return loomhttp.EncodingFunc(func(any) error {
			return cause
		})
	}
	err = client.EncodeEncodedRequest(factory)(req, &svc.EncodedPayload{Value: "x"})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, cause)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, closeCause)
}

func (s *service) Optional(_ context.Context, p *svc.OptionalPayload, body io.ReadCloser) error {
	data, err := io.ReadAll(body)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if p.Length != nil && int64(len(data)) != *p.Length {
		return errors.New("incorrect bytes")
	}
	s.length <- p.Length
	return nil
}
func (*service) Required(context.Context, *svc.RequiredPayload, io.ReadCloser) error {
	return nil
}
func (*service) Named(context.Context, *svc.NamedPayload, io.ReadCloser) error {
	return nil
}
func (*service) Encoded(context.Context, *svc.EncodedPayload) error {
	return nil
}
func (*service) Form(context.Context, *svc.FormPayload) error {
	return nil
}
func (*service) Ordinary(context.Context, *svc.OrdinaryPayload) error {
	return nil
}
func (b *countedBody) Close() error {
	b.closes.Add(1)
	return nil
}
func (d *doer) Do(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	d.calls.Add(1)
	return nil, errors.New("unexpected request")
}

func (*failingCloser) Read([]byte) (int, error) {
	return 0, io.EOF
}
func (b *failingCloser) Close() error {
	return b.cause
}
